text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Restrained in flashiness yet glamorous... 
As expected, a V-neck dress would be best.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Groove, have you made up your mind?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Anything is fine by me. It is not as if 
I have any particular preference.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... You really have very little 
interest, don't you. This upcoming fan 
meet-and-greet is supposed to be your big 
moment in the spotlight as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The ones appearing are the Tiara horse 
girls who have gained immense popularity 
from countless fans and received official 
invitations from the URA—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Both you and I were chosen among them. You 
should take pride in the honor and present 
an appearance befitting of it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I couldn't care less about stuff like 
that.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I... only run for my own sake. I don't 
need anyone's popularity or expectations.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Dressing up for the sake of others is 
utterly pointless.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...For the sake of others, you say?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph, perhaps this is a good 
opportunity. Follow me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I shall instruct you in one thing. 
...About the art of makeup.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I have no idea what you're talking 
about. How did you even arrive at that 
conclusion?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
At this meet-and-greet, your figure will 
be etched into the hearts of the fans. 
Polishing your appearance will certainly 
do you no harm.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Just one single lesson. Beyond that, I 
will not meddle in your affairs. ...Well?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Just one lesson, right? ...Then let's get 
it over with quickly.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Regarding the eyeliner I am about to show 
you, a liquid type should suit you best. 
...Have you ever learned makeup from 
anyone before?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I've had no need to. I can learn 
something like makeup entirely on my own.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Is that so. ...Heh, then it seems teaching 
you will be well worth the effort.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
How you draw the eyeliner is crucial. Be 
mindful of sweeping the line upward with 
intent...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Splendid, excellent progress. ...Fufu, 
you're quite skilled at this, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —There, that should do it. Take a look.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Ah, ...this is...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Lip gloss and face powder... This should 
be quite sufficient for your cosmetics.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Still baffled? That a mere touch of 
eyeliner could make you look so dignified 
and sharp?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...All you did was change the eyeliner. 
And yet, there's so much elegance...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Cosmetics hold precisely that kind of 
power. ...The power to bring you closer to 
the figure you desire with a single 
technique.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You mentioned earlier, that there is no 
need to dress up for the sake of others—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And that is fine. Because makeup exists 
for one's own sake.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ! ...For my own sake...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We possess the means to embody our own 
ideals. ...Never forget that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after the fan meet-and-greet 
hosted by the URA. As I read the event 
report article posted on the bulletin 
board—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the horse girl in the 
photograph—Admire Groove in her stunning 
dress, I was left completely speechless.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her dignified presence was as cold as ice. 
An aloof and solitary beauty that felt as 
if it would freeze you solid from the feet 
up just by drawing near.
—Truly, just like an Ice Queen.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Especially that eyeliner accentuating her 
dignified aura... Frankly, I was amazed. 
To think you could achieve such makeup 
entirely on your own.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I merely studied it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
To demonstrate my strength alone, without 
needing anyone's help. —I did it simply to 
show that off.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, is that so.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It is a magnificent sight to behold, Alve.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Not really. It's just that I don't want 
to get involved with anyone.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Good grief... You never change, do you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. ...It is truly strange. No matter 
how much she pushes me away, I still find 
myself wanting to be an ideal figure for 
her.
choice_data_list:
Like how the most troublesome juniors end 
up the dearest?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, who knows.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hm, me...? Naturally. I stood on that 
stage as the "Empress," after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
To the fans, and to all the other horse 
girls. I must display what a true ideal 
looks like.
